openrouter.note: Token prices from the OpenRouter model list. Each pattern picks the newest matching model. Blend = (3 × input + output) / 4, in $ per million tokens.

eia.note: US commercial retail electricity price (EIA API v2, monthly, cents per kWh). Index 2023 = 100 uses the 2023 average of 12.59 cents.

edgar.note: Quarterly capex of the Big-4 from SEC XBRL company facts; year-to-date figures are differenced into quarters.

epoch.note: Open-weight lag from the Epoch Capabilities Index (CC BY 4.0): months between a closed model reaching a score and the best open-weight model reaching it.

research.ask: Sum of the latest announced post-money equity valuations of OpenAI and Anthropic (funding rounds or tender offers). Give each component with its date.
